units.Gb(i): W/m2 direct irradiance on requested plane
units.Gd(i): W/m2 diffuse irradiance on requested plane
units.Gr(i): W/m2 reflected irradiance on requested plane

measurement_uncertainty.description: The point-query response does not report per-value measurement uncertainty; it combines satellite-derived irradiance and ERA5 reanalysis meteorology.

known_gaps: PVGIS-SARAH irradiance is instantaneous at the satellite observation minute, not an hourly interval average.
The selected seriescalc fields omit relative humidity, atmospheric pressure, and wind direction.
DNI is derived from horizontal beam irradiance and sun height and is undefined close to the horizon.
Satellite and reanalysis values are forcing-plausibility evidence rather than exact ground truth.

preprocessing.description: Select representative raw rows and record normalized fields, units, missing fields, derived fields, and source time semantics.

permitted_use.notes: PVGIS states that its information is free with no restrictions on use; attribution and immutable query metadata are retained for reproducibility.
